svg.title: From events to shared, permissioned context
svg.desc: One platform; durable queries, live updates, media delivery, and delegated task execution.

g.text: From events to shared, permissioned context
One platform; durable queries, live updates, media delivery, and delegated task execution.
Metadata joins the event / graph pipeline
User identity, workspace and entity access
Domain APIs · Operational dashboards · Search and chat · Task-driven applications
Storage credentials stay with platform services. Applications access the graph through permissioned APIs.
